info.name: FLOW - Single-DS Entity-Layer Realm + Ingestion
info.description: Product-faithful schema build: create each entity one-by-one via POST /entity (server stamps identity/tenant), assemble the schema graph from the entity-graph (datasource-subgraph), then realm + real ingestion. Creds via env-vars. Any stream that does not land rows fails the flow.

exec: // Skip token refresh if using admin token (e.g. for tenant delete)
(e,res)=>{ if(e||res.code!==200){ throw new Error('token fetch failed: '+(e||res.status)); }
// 5xx is a real server failure — register a failing assertion so it can't pass silently.
if(code>=500){ pm.test('[api] server '+code+' @ '+pm.info.requestName+' :: '+msg, () => { throw new Error(code+' '+msg); }); }
console.log('Setup: state cleared for env=' + pm.environment.get('env_name'));
// Build the JDBC datasource body dynamically. dbPort is OMITTED when empty — snowflake
// has no port, and sending dbPort:'' makes the server 400 'Failed to read request'
// Extract dsName from dataCatalogName for metadata lookup
// metadata API needs the last segment (name_schema part)
// Build dsPrefix from datasource name (DS-side entity namespace — unchanged).
// Accumulate raw DS metadata for the UI schema-graph builder (supports multi-DS).
// Tag with _dsId so the builder can set dataSourceID (needed for Trino catalog resolution).
// Extract entities from graph response (hasTableEdges → tableNode)
if(next<n){ pm.collectionVariables.set('_entIdx', String(next)); postman.setNextRequest('03 Create Entity'); }
else { pm.collectionVariables.set('_entCount', String(n)); pm.collectionVariables.unset('_entIdx'); console.log('ALL '+n+' entities created'); }
// stamp schema prefix nodeId + schemaId (exactly what UICore stampNodeIds does)
console.log('schema-graph saved from '+ent+' entities ('+nodes.length+' nodes) versionId='+vid);
console.log('schema-graph read back: '+ns.length+' nodes, '+ent.length+' entities, '+stamped+' with identity');
else if(a<18){ pm.collectionVariables.set('_nsAttempt', String(a+1)); postman.setNextRequest('10 Wait Namespace UP'); }
if(!done){ pm.collectionVariables.set('_ingAttempt', String(a+1)); postman.setNextRequest('12 Verify Tables Landed'); return; }
if(missing.length===0 && expected.length>0){ console.log('INGESTION VALIDATED: '+expected.length+' tables, rows='+JSON.stringify(landed)); }
else { console.log('DATAFLOW FAILED: '+missing.length+'/'+expected.length+' stream(s) did not land: '+JSON.stringify(missing)); }

pm.test('12 all '+expected.length+' table(s) ingested rows (missing: '+JSON.stringify(missing)+')', () => { pm.expect(expected.length).to.be.above(0); pm.expect(missing, 'tables with 0 rows').to.eql([]); });
